andrew: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a compact page-handshake lifecycle interface for offload/evict coordination. TL;DR: single small API for runtime <-> allocator to manage page ownership, residency, and soft-evict signals.

lina: Nice. Do you mean a blocking call or an async token model?

andrew: Async token model. Caller gets a token immediately; runtime uses token to place page, mark resident. Eviction uses revoke(token) and returns grace window.

carlos: How's this different from existing lease/lease-revocation ideas? We need to avoid races with compact/defrag.

andrew: Main diffs: 1) tiny handshake (claim/accept/revoke/confirm) 2) explicit 'resident' vs 'staged' states 3) integrated backpressure header for tenant quotas 4) eviction callbacks with soft/hard semantics.

mira: Can you paste a sketch?

andrew: ```
claim_page(page_id, owner_id) -> token || ERR_BUSY
accept(token) -> resident
stage(token, host_addr) -> staged
revoke(token, mode=soft|hard) -> grace_ms
confirm_revoke(token) -> freed|sleep
```

andrew: Soft revoke returns grace window and lets runtime flush KV cache or checkpoint. Hard revoke times out and allocator may preempt.

lina: How do we avoid double-free if accept -> staged -> revoke racing with migration?

andrew: Tokens are versioned+holder-signed. accept returns a token with epoch; revoke only affects current epoch. Also owner must attach token to any downstream pin ops.

carlos: Perf: extra round trips? we should batch claims for tiny allocations.

mira: Also need observable metrics per-token: age, revoke-count, avg-grace.

andrew: Agreed. Add hooks: on_revoke, on_revoked, on_confirm. We can piggyback on existing pin/unpin paths.

offload-bot: deploy-checklist: remember to add schema migrations for token metadata and add 10k token/sec medians to telemetry.

lina: Edge case: cross-node migration. token must be transferable or produce a new token at dest.

andrew: Proposal: token has transfer() semantically: origin issues 'transfer_intent' and dest does 'accept_transfer' which bumps epoch. If origin doesn't confirm within grace -> origin can be revoked.

carlos: Does this interact with prefix/KV cache? We must ensure stale KV not served after revoke.

mira: Add TTL on cached entries tied to token epoch. On accept/transfer, cache owner rotates namespace.

andrew: :thumbsup: I'll update the RFC doc with the state machine and a small prototype API. Next step: sync with alloc + s-rep teams. Who can review API surface?

lina: I can take API review. Mira will take telemetry.

carlos: I'll prototype batching logic.

mira: I'll write evict tests and a small harness.

andrew: Thanks. I'll post a follow-up PR with API sketch + sequence diagrams.
